tenderSchedule.description:
P




roviding security guards and security supervisor to APMC Bangalore

tenderAddress.blockNumber: OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY MG COMPLEX APMC BANGALORE

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder Should have deployed a minimum 56 Nos manpower services during the past THREE years in previous FIVE years for one Stat/Central Government Department/ Organisations/ Undertakings/Corporations/private companies Services rendered should be satisfactory. The applicant/ bidder shall submit running contract labour licence under Rule 25(1) of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970
Tenderer has to submit the Returns of ESI, PF and GST, Professional Tax

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Returns of ESI, PF and GST, Professional Tax

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have filed GST Returns up to Date

The bidder should be in business of providing manpower services for last FIVE financial year and should have labor license for minimum 56 employees for last FIVE financial year (i.e. 2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25, 2025-26)
The agency must have valid licence as per The Karnataka Private Security Agencies Rules 2008
Declaration for non blocklisting of the firm anywhere in INDIA
The Security Agency must have walki-talki facilities, & must provide 12 No.s walki-talki sets, & also one table top walki-talki for Office use
The Security Agency must have Body camera facilities, & must provide 25 No.s body camera to security guards
The Security Agency must have one 4 wheeler patrolling vehicle

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RC COPY OR LEASE AGREEMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have mandatory software deployment to deploy dedicated GPS/ Geofence software tracking on all guard devices with offline backup capability

The Organization should have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.3.5Crores (Rupees three crores fifty lakhs only) during any three years of last 5 financial years i.e., in FY 2021-22 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25, & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: IT Returns Copies for the last 5 financial years (i.e. FY 2021-22 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 2025-26 )
The bidder should not have been Black listed by Govt. of Karnataka/ Other State Govts / Central Government Departments /Organisations /Undertakings / Corporations
The bidder shouldnot have filed for bankruptcy or insolvency during the last two years
No sub-contracting or sub-lease is allowed
